decisions.reason: The source changes the formatting and detail level of result drivers, not the score panel fields, score prominence, heading, spacing, or result visibility owned by this Requirement.
The confidential distribution warning is independently changed by another clause in message 42; simplifying front-page result drivers does not alter it.
The vehicle identification display is independently addressed by the vehicle-group clause and is unaffected by the result-driver formatting change.
Allowing longer result explanations elsewhere does not necessarily change the coverage, presentation, or text of internal page headers.
The source refinement is localized to front-page result-driver presentation and does not modify the existing cross-variant visual theme or general design direction.
Shortening result-driver copy on page one does not change which customer fields must be editable or the assessment-date field format.
The DX-17 header identifier is independently established by another clause in message 42 and is unaffected by result-driver formatting.
The source permits longer explanation elsewhere but does not require a change to the candidate's assessment-date placeholder policy.
The front-page result-driver refinement does not change footer presence or footer content.
The change does not alter the required DX17–DX20 variant set, editability, or score-based selection rule.
The source concerns explanatory result drivers rather than the scoring table's format or required scoring fields.
The result-driver formatting refinement does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their delivery.
